summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found from a read-only audit (no code changed):**  The watchlist code itself looks correctly wired end-to-end: - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, validates it via `getSession()`, and injects `X-User-Id` — same pattern as portfolio. - Every route (list, create, get, update, delete, add item, remove item) filters/verifies by `user_id`, so there's no shared/anonymous watchlist and no hardcoded default id. - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localSto
